input: Set up bug/feature reports, feedback and anonymous usage stats from the GitHub Pages site, landing back in the repo for agents; do as much as possible, owner does the rest.
errors: First wrangler dev run failed: a Worker main module exported constants (workerd allows only handlers); moved pure logic to platform/edge/feedback.mjs.
Duplicate REPO_URL import in build.mjs (already imported from engineering.mjs); removed.

doc_friction.issue: 'No analytics vendor' and the Hetzner/k3s counter section were stale after the 2026-10-01 retirement and the owner's 2026-10-20 direction; rewritten in this PR.
Counter tests were documented but not run by any CI workflow; added to portfolio-validate.
Printed 'git failed' with an empty message on this clone and exited 0, so the guard silently did nothing.

The checklist caught five real issues CI would have (runner switch, publish surface, dogfood, coverage, site_usage known pages); none of these rules is mentioned where new workflows or top-level pages are added.

deviations.why: Route drew research; the owner's named task is platform/process work, so routed with --track process.

notes: Owner asked for site bug reports, feedback and usage stats into the repo. Shipped issue forms, a feedback page linked from every tool, a Cloudflare Worker (feedback->issues, counts in D1) verified in wrangler dev, two off-by-default workflows, and the owner's new privacy rule. Owner must create the Cloudflare account and tokens. Pre-existing faq-visible failure (xero-invoice-csv-check) also fails on main. Revised on owner request: no-account feedback is stored in D1 and committed daily to portfolio/usage/site-feedback.json instead of opening issues, so the Worker holds no GitHub credential. CI queued with no runner, so the verify-and-merge checklist was run locally before merging: pages suite 1162/1162, gitops 603 after fixes, platform/ci unit tests; fixed checkout credential persistence, runner switch, publish-surface classification, checklist coverage and the site_usage known-page list that the checklist caught.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: Worker + tests, site page and copy, workflows, docs: about 1.5 engineer days

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
